name: get_current_time
description: Returns the current date and time in an IANA time zone, including the UTC offset, the English weekday and whether daylight saving time is in effect.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name such as 'America/New_York' or 'Europe/London'. Use 'UTC' (the server's local time zone) if the user does not name one.
IANA time zone name exactly as requested.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date and time with UTC offset, such as 2024-01-01T13:00:00+01:00.

day_of_week.description: English weekday name, such as Monday.

is_dst.description: True when daylight saving time is in effect at that moment.

name: convert_time
description: Converts a wall-clock time from one IANA time zone to another and reports the offset difference in hours. Handles daylight saving time, quarter-hour offsets and date boundaries.

source_timezone.description: IANA time zone the given time is in, such as 'Europe/Vienna'. Use 'UTC' (the server's local time zone) if the user does not name a source time zone.

time.description: Time to convert in 24-hour HH:MM format, such as '14:30'.

target_timezone.description: IANA time zone to convert to, such as 'Asia/Tokyo'. Use 'UTC' (the server's local time zone) if the user does not name a target time zone.

date.description: Optional date of the time to convert in YYYY-MM-DD format, such as '2024-03-10'. Defaults to today in the source time zone.

source.title: TimeResult
source.description: The given time in the source time zone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name exactly as requested.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date and time with UTC offset, such as 2024-01-01T13:00:00+01:00.

day_of_week.description: English weekday name, such as Monday.

is_dst.description: True when daylight saving time is in effect at that moment.

target.title: TimeResult
target.description: The same moment in the target time zone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name exactly as requested.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date and time with UTC offset, such as 2024-01-01T13:00:00+01:00.

day_of_week.description: English weekday name, such as Monday.

is_dst.description: True when daylight saving time is in effect at that moment.

time_difference.description: UTC offset of the target minus the source time zone in hours, such as +5.75h or -4.0h.
